DEPENDENCY LICENSE FALLBACKS

Some npm packages declare a license in package.json but omit the license file
from the published package tarball. The build notice generator uses this file
only for the package families listed below. A newly encountered package with
no bundled license file fails the build until its notice is reviewed.

License text supplied by another package in the same upstream project:

- @next/env and @next/swc-* use the Next.js MIT notice.
- client-only uses the React MIT notice.
- @astrojs/compiler-binding-* uses the @astrojs/compiler-binding notice.
- @bruits/satteri-* uses the satteri notice.
- @esbuild/* uses the esbuild notice.
- @rolldown/binding-* uses the rolldown notice.

The complete Apache License 2.0 text appears in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and
also applies to drizzle-orm and workerd packages that declare Apache-2.0.
The Cloudflare Workers SDK packages may be used under MIT or Apache-2.0.

SHARP LIBVIPS BINARY PACKAGES

Applies to @img/sharp-libvips-* packages.

These packages declare LGPL-3.0-or-later and provide prebuilt libvips and
dependency binaries for sharp. Source, build scripts, component versions, and
platform packaging are available from:

https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips

The published package README states that the binary contains the following
third-party libraries under their respective terms:

| Library | License |
|---------|---------|
| aom | BSD 2-Clause and Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0 |
| cairo | Mozilla Public License 2.0 |
| cgif | MIT |
| expat | MIT |
| fontconfig | fontconfig license (BSD-like) |
| freetype | FreeType license (BSD-like) |
| fribidi | LGPLv3 |
| glib | LGPLv3 |
| harfbuzz | MIT |
| highway | BSD 3-Clause |
| lcms | MIT |
| libarchive | BSD 2-Clause |
| libexif | LGPLv3 |
| libffi | MIT |
| libheif | LGPLv3 |
| libimagequant | BSD 2-Clause |
| libnsgif | MIT |
| libpng | libpng license |
| librsvg | LGPLv3 |
| libtiff | libtiff license (BSD-like) |
| libultrahdr | MIT |
| libvips | LGPLv3 |
| libwebp | New BSD |
| libxml2 | MIT |
| mozjpeg | zlib, IJG, and BSD 3-Clause |
| pango | LGPLv3 |
| pixman | MIT |
| proxy-libintl | LGPLv3 |
| zlib-ng | zlib |

Use of libraries under LGPLv3 is through the "any later version" clause of
LGPLv2 or LGPLv2.1. The exact component versions are recorded in each
published package's versions.json file.
